cards.title: Compartmental Model Parameterization and Saturable Kinetics
cards.claim: PK models can be parameterized via Micro (rate constants), Clearance (clearance terms), or Macro (sum of exponentials) approaches. Saturable elimination (Michaelis-Menten) is modeled using Vmax and Km. For extravascular administration, absorption rate (Ka) is added. In some cases, Ka is set equal to Ke. Macro models require a 'stripping dose' assumption to derive volume.
limitations: Macro parameterization requires explicit dose assumptions for volume derivation
Saturable models require sufficient data to estimate Km and Vmax
